svg.title: Accrue palette specimen
svg.desc: Accrue brand palette: 7 raw --accrue-* tokens + semantic roles on light and dark surfaces. AA status sourced from WCAG 2.x contrast-table.txt: Moss 3.03:1 AA-large (FAIL AA-body on light); Cobalt 3.66:1 AA-large (FAIL AA-body on light); Amber 2.66:1 FAIL (FAIL AA on light). On dark (Ink #0f1318): Moss 5.89:1, Cobalt 4.86:1, Amber 6.71:1 — all AA-body.
